# Oracle

> Oracle's enterprise cloud applications and solutions for ERP, HCM, CRM, healthcare, and supply chain management powered by AI agents and data intelligence.

Oracle provides comprehensive cloud-based business applications and platforms serving enterprises across finance, human resources, customer experience, healthcare, and supply chain operations. The site features product documentation, comparisons, best practices, and implementation guides for Oracle Fusion Cloud and specialized solutions.

## Key Topics

- Oracle Fusion Cloud
- AI Agents
- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
- Human Capital Management (HCM)
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
- Healthcare IT / EHR
- Supply Chain Management
- Cloud Migration
- Business Intelligence
- Digital Transformation
- Transportation Management
- Sales Performance Management
- Marketing Automation
- Employee Experience
- Data Management

## Enterprise Resource Planning & Finance

- [15 Top Cloud ERP Benefits & Reasons to Move](https://www.oracle.com/erp/cloud-erp-benefits): Cloud ERP benefits and SaaS migration advantages for enterprises
- [10 Differences between Oracle and SAP](https://www.oracle.com/erp/oracle-vs-sap/differentiators): Comparison of Oracle Fusion Cloud and SAP S/4HANA ERP solutions
- [14 CFO Best Practices for 2024](https://www.oracle.com/erp/cfo/cfo-best-practices): CFO best practices for financial strategy and digital transformation
- [What Is the Metaverse](https://www.oracle.com/erp/ai-financials/what-is-the-metaverse): Metaverse definition covering XR, AR, VR, and virtual economy concepts

## Human Capital Management & Workforce

- [Strategies for the CHRO](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/best-hr): CHRO strategies with AI agents and Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM
- [What Is the Employee Experience?](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/employee-experience/what-is-employee-experience): Guide to employee experience, engagement, and retention strategies
- [What Is Recruiting Software?](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/recruiting/what-is-recruiting-software): Guide to recruiting software, ATS, and AI-powered hiring management
- [The Real Cost of Turnover in Healthcare](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/cost-employee-turnover-healthcare): Healthcare employee turnover costs and workforce retention strategies

## Customer Experience & Sales

- [Oracle is a Leader in CRM Customer Engagement Center (CEC)](https://www.oracle.com/applications/crm-customer-engagement-center-gartner-mq): Oracle CRM Customer Engagement Center recognized in Gartner Magic Quadrant
- [Sales Performance Management](https://www.oracle.com/cx/sales/sales-performance-management): Oracle Sales Performance Management and incentive compensation solutions
- [Marketing automation scalability and reliability](https://www.oracle.com/cx/marketing/automation/eloqua-scalability-reliability): Oracle Eloqua platform scalability, reliability, and performance metrics

## Supply Chain & Logistics

- [Product Tour—Machine learning for transit time prediction](https://www.oracle.com/scm/logistics/transportation-management/transportation-management-tour): Oracle Transportation Management product tour with ML-based ETA prediction
- [Oracle Transportation Management: Fleet Management Product Tour](https://www.oracle.com/scm/logistics/transportation-management/fleet-management-product-tour): Fleet Management product tour for shipment optimization and tracking

## Healthcare Solutions

- [Reporting and Analytics](https://www.oracle.com/health/reporting-analytics): Oracle Health analytics, BI, and AI data platform for healthcare insights
- [i.s.h.med](https://www.oracle.com/health/ishmed): i.s.h.med EHR system for healthcare clinical workflows and records

## Oracle Fusion Cloud & AI Automation

- [Agents That Know Your Business: The Oracle Fusion Advantage](https://www.oracle.com/applications/agents-that-know-your-business): Oracle Fusion AI agents for business automation and workflow intelligence
- [On-premise limitations, cloud possibilities: AI Strategies for Leaders](https://www.oracle.com/applications/effective-ai-strategies): AI strategy guide for cloud migration and Oracle Fusion adoption

## Enterprise Visualization & Data Management

- [AutoVue Enterprise Visualization Solutions](https://www.oracle.com/applications/autovue): AutoVue enterprise visualization for CAD, engineering, and document collaboration
- [Test-drive Enterprise Data Management (EDM)](https://www.oracle.com/performance-management/enterprise-data-management/rapid-start): Oracle EDM Rapid Start program for testing and cloud migration
